author: reek
body: One month in the life of a demo company. The scenario runs every subledger against a single general ledger: procure-to-pay, make-to-stock, order-to-cash, payroll, cost allocation, and a month-end close, then renders the trial balance and statements. This chapter deliberately defines no opening; the battery test and the bootable demo both cite it and provide their own entry points.

author: reek
body: Each step threads the ledger forward. The result record carries the final state plus everything the report needs to tie subledgers to control accounts.

author: reek
body: The month continues in run-month-rest; splitting the function keeps the let chain shallow enough to read.
